dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: The immunophenotype is non-germinal-center B-cell-like by the Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: DLBCL-NOS with an activated B-cell-like/non-GCB phenotype

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage III, bulky, with B symptoms.

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: The spleen is a lymphatic organ in the Lugano system, so splenic involvement remains stage III rather than IV

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: He has bulky stage III disease with B symptoms (fevers, drenching night sweats, and 7-kg weight loss).

mol_de_not_dh.quote: so this is a double-expressor DLBCL, not a double-hit/high-grade B-cell lymphoma

prog_ipi_3.quote: Standard IPI is 3 (age over 60, stage III, elevated LDH; ECOG 1 and no extranodal sites), which is high-intermediate risk

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI 3 (age over 60, stage III, elevated LDH; ECOG 1, no more than one extranodal site, and no kidney/adrenal involvement), which is a high-risk category
prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.note: Score of 3 is correct and spleen not counted, but it is mislabelled as high-risk rather than intermediate.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: I recommend 6 cycles of R-CHOP21 given with curative intent

tx_pola_preferred.quote: I am choosing R-CHOP as the default because overall survival is similar

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: if there is PET-positive residual bulky disease, I would biopsy it and consider involved-site radiation or second-line therapy

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir) for prophylaxis because anti-HBc is positive, continue for at least 12 months after rituximab

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: continue for at least 12 months after rituximab, and monitor HBV DNA
hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.note: Baseline and ongoing HBV DNA ordered; LFT monitoring not explicitly stated.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I will perform a baseline lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry
cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.note: Declines routine prophylaxis and MRI, but orders routine baseline LP and calls risk high.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: end-of-treatment FDG PET-CT from skull base to mid-thigh approximately 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted by Lugano/Deauville criteria

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 indicates residual disease and should prompt biopsy of the residual site if feasible

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: allopurinol 300 mg daily (renal-adjusted) before cycle 1, hydration at 2-3 L/m2/day as tolerated

sup_gcsf.quote: Febrile neutropenia: pegfilgrastim 6 mg on day 2 of each cycle

work_echo_reviewed.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative-intent therapy: age 62, ECOG 1, fully independent
work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF 58% cited as part of fitness, not explicitly as anthracycline clearance.

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative-intent therapy

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Baseline HBV DNA level and confirmation that HBV antiviral prophylaxis has been started.
